package v

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4"
	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4/middleware"
)

func TestBalancers(t *testing.T) {
	rb := middleware.NewRandomBalancer(nil)
	fmt.Println("random nil:", rb.Next(nil))
	rrb := middleware.NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*middleware.ProxyTarget{})
	fmt.Println("rr nil:", rrb.Next(nil))
	// with targets
	rrb.AddTarget(&middleware.ProxyTarget{Name: "a"})
	fmt.Println("rr a:", rrb.Next(nil).Name)
}

func TestPath(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	e.GET("/users/:id", func(c echo.Context) error { return c.String(200, c.Path()) })
	e.HTTPErrorHandler = func(err error, c echo.Context) {
		fmt.Printf("err handler path=%q\n", c.Path())
		c.NoContent(http.StatusNotFound)
	}
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/does-not-exist", nil)
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	req = httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/users/1", nil)
	rec = httptest.NewRecorder()
	e.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	fmt.Println("matched path:", rec.Body.String())
}

func TestScheme(t *testing.T) {
	e := echo.New()
	req := httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil)
	c := e.NewContext(req, httptest.NewRecorder())
	req.Header.Set("X-Forwarded-Proto", "ftp")
	req.Header.Set("X-Url-Scheme", "https")
	fmt.Println("scheme:", c.Scheme())
	req.Header.Del("X-Url-Scheme")
	fmt.Println("scheme only bogus:", c.Scheme())
	req.Header.Set("X-Forwarded-Proto", "https")
	fmt.Println("scheme valid:", c.Scheme())
}
EOF
cd /tmp/v && cat > go.mod <<'EOF'

go 1.15

require github.com/labstack/echo/v4 v4.0.0
EOF
go mod edit -replace github.com/labstack/echo/v4=/echo && go mod tidy >/dev/null 2>&1; go test -run 'TestBalancers|TestPath|TestScheme' -v ./... 2>&1 | head -40

package echo

import (
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"github.com/labstack/echo/v4/middleware"
)

func TestZZConcurrentBalancer(t *testing.T) {
	rrb := middleware.NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*middleware.ProxyTarget{{Name: "a"}, {Name: "b"}})
	rb := middleware.NewRandomBalancer([]*middleware.ProxyTarget{{Name: "a"}, {Name: "b"}})
	e := New()
	c := e.NewContext(httptest.NewRequest(http.MethodGet, "/", nil), httptest.NewRecorder())
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for i := 0; i < 20; i++ {
		wg.Add(2)
		go func() { defer wg.Done(); for j := 0; j < 100; j++ { rrb.Next(c) } }()
		go func() { defer wg.Done(); for j := 0; j < 100; j++ { rb.Next(c) } }()
	}
	wg.Wait()
}
EOF
go test -race -run TestZZConcurrentBalancer . 2>&1 | tail -5; rm zz_race_test.go; go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -5

Fixed. Both balancers now return `nil` when their target list is empty instead of panicking.

- `middleware/proxy.go` — `randomBalancer.Next` returns `nil` before calling `rand.Intn` when `len(targets) == 0` (fixes `panic: invalid argument to Intn`).
- `middleware/proxy.go` — `roundRobinBalancer.Next` returns `nil` before the modulo when `len(targets) == 0` (fixes `panic: runtime error: integer divide by zero`); it now also takes the balancer's write lock since it mutates the round-robin index.

Verified: `NewRandomBalancer(nil).Next(c)` and `NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{}).Next(c)` both return `nil`, and normal (non-empty) balancing still works.

Fixed. `Router.Find` (`router.go`) no longer seeds `ctx.path` with the *requested* path; the path is only set to the registered route path once a route node is matched. For an unmatched request `c.Path()` is now `""` (matching the `Path()` doc: "returns the registered path for the handler"), while matched requests still report the registered route (e.g. `/users/:id`). Verified with an `HTTPErrorHandler` printing `c.Path()` for `/does-not-exist` → `""`.

Fixed. Both balancers now return `nil` when their target list is empty instead of panicking.

- `middleware/proxy.go` — `randomBalancer.Next` returns `nil` before calling `rand.Intn` when `len(targets) == 0` (fixes `panic: invalid argument to Intn`).
- `middleware/proxy.go` — `roundRobinBalancer.Next` returns `nil` before the modulo when `len(targets) == 0` (fixes `panic: runtime error: integer divide by zero`); it now also takes the balancer's write lock since it mutates the round-robin index.

Verified: `NewRandomBalancer(nil).Next(c)` and `NewRoundRobinBalancer([]*ProxyTarget{}).Next(c)` both return `nil`, and normal (non-empty) balancing still works.

Fixed. `Router.Find` (`router.go`) no longer seeds `ctx.path` with the *requested* path; the path is only set to the registered route path once a route node is matched. For an unmatched request `c.Path()` is now `""` (matching the `Path()` doc: "returns the registered path for the handler"), while matched requests still report the registered route (e.g. `/users/:id`). Verified with an `HTTPErrorHandler` printing `c.Path()` for `/does-not-exist` → `""`.

Fixed. `context.Scheme()` (`context.go`) now only accepts `http`/`https` from the `X-Forwarded-Proto`, `X-Forwarded-Protocol` and `X-Url-Scheme` headers; any other value is ignored and the next source is consulted, falling back to `http` if none is valid. So `X-Forwarded-Proto: ftp` + `X-Url-Scheme: https` → `https`, bogus-only → `http`, and valid values still return as before. Verified against the reported scenario; the existing `TestContext_Scheme` table still passes.
